story.text: 모처럼 비번이 겹친 주말이었다. 하늘도 나도 딱히 계획이 없었다.
story.reading: mo-cheo-reom bi-beon-i gyeop-chin ju-mal-i-eot-da. ha-neul-do na-do ttak-hi gye-hoeg-i eop-seot-da.
story.en: It was a rare weekend when our days off overlapped. Neither Haneul nor I had any particular plans.

story.text: '뭐 할 거야?' 내가 묻자, 그는 잠시 뜸을 들이더니 말했다. '나 사진 찍는 거 취미야.'
story.reading: 'mwo hal geo-ya?' nae-ga mud-ja, geu-neun jam-si tteum-eul deul-i-deo-ni mal-haet-da. 'na sa-jin jjik-neun geo chwi-mi-ya.'
story.en: "What do you want to do?" I asked. He paused for a moment, then said, "Taking photos — that's my hobby."

story.text: 의외였다. 무뚝뚝한 그가 카메라를 들면 다른 사람처럼 조용히 집중했다.
story.reading: ui-oe-yeot-da. mu-ttuk-ttuk-han geu-ga ka-me-ra-reul deul-myeon da-reun sa-ram-cheo-reom jo-yong-hi jip-jung-haet-da.
story.en: It was unexpected. When he picked up a camera, the blunt version of him turned quiet and focused, like a different person.

story.text: '전주천 따라 산책이나 하자. 걷다가 찍고 싶은 거 있으면 찍고.' 그가 앞장서 걸었다.
story.reading: 'jeon-ju-cheon tta-ra san-chaek-i-na ha-ja. geot-da-ga jjik-go sip-eun geo iss-eu-myeon jjik-go.' geu-ga ap-jang-seo geol-eot-da.
story.en: "Let's just take a walk along Jeonjucheon. If we see something worth shooting, we'll shoot it." He led the way, walking ahead.

story.text: '너무 열심히 하지 마. 주말인데 쉬어야지.' 내가 놀리듯 말하자, 그는 픽 웃었다.
story.reading: 'neo-mu yeol-sim-hi ha-ji ma. ju-mal-in-de swi-eo-ya-ji.' nae-ga nol-li-deut mal-ha-ja, geu-neun pik us-eot-da.
story.en: "Don't try too hard. It's the weekend — you're supposed to rest." I teased, and he gave a small smile.

story.text: '이런 게 나한텐 쉬는 거야.' 그가 무심히 답하며 렌즈를 갈아 끼웠다. 나는 그 말이 왠지 마음에 남았다.
story.reading: 'i-reon ge na-han-ten swi-neun geo-ya.' geu-ga mu-sim-hi dap-ha-myeo ren-jeu-reul gal-a kki-wot-da. na-neun geu mal-i waen-ji ma-eum-e nam-at-da.
story.en: "This kind of thing is resting, for me." He answered offhandedly, changing his lens. Somehow, the words stuck with me.

story.text: '너도 좋아하는 거 하나 말해봐.' 그가 카메라 너머로 물었다. 나는 잠깐 고민하다 웃으며 답했다. '지금 이 순간, 이런 거.'
story.reading: 'neo-do jo-a-ha-neun geo ha-na mal-hae-bwa.' geu-ga ka-me-ra neo-meo-ro mul-eot-da. na-neun jam-kkan go-min-ha-da us-eu-myeo dap-haet-da. 'ji-geum i sun-gan, i-reon geo.'
story.en: "Tell me one thing you like too." He asked from behind the camera. I thought for a second, then answered with a smile. "This moment, right now — things like this."

story.text: 그는 대답 대신 셔터를 눌렀다. 딸깍, 조용한 소리가 우리의 주말을 한 장면으로 남겼다.
story.reading: geu-neun dae-dap dae-sin syeo-teo-reul nul-leot-da. ttal-kkak, jo-yong-han so-ri-ga u-ri-ui ju-mal-eul han jang-myeon-eu-ro nam-gyeot-da.
story.en: Instead of answering, he pressed the shutter. A quiet click captured our weekend into a single frame.

words.example_en: What do you do on weekends?
I want to rest at home today.
Let's go for a walk in the evening.

sentences.en: What will you do this weekend?
I want to rest a bit today.
Shall we take a walk together?
I like this kind of thing.
